instruction.text: Read the story. Then answer the questions.

atoms.text: The legendary dragon Magnifica was the ruler of a magical forest. She believed that she had absolute authority over the whole forest and that all animals had to do what she told them to do.
atoms.sound: The legendary dragon Magnifica was the ruler of a magical forest. She believed that she had absolute authority over the whole forest, and that all animals had to do what she told them to do.

atoms.text: She was a peculiar dragon with a bushy tail and small, brown eyes. But she was keeping a big secret — in fact, she wasn’t a dragon at all but rather a squirrel! No one knew about this because no other animal had ever seen Magnifica before. She ruled only through fear and oppression.

b: a good friend who loves to share their toys

having tea with the prime minister’s family

atoms.text: Magnifica was convinced that she deserved all the nuts for herself and that the other animals should accept her as their queen. However, many animals had doubts, since they weren’t even sure if Magnifica was a real dragon. Indeed, some animals in the forest had heard rumours that their ruler was a squirrel and not a dragon, but no one was brave enough to confront her.

What does it mean to be convinced about something?
b: to be madly in love with something

atoms.text: The previous rulers of the magical forest had been much nicer than Magnifica. It had been a tradition to distribute all nuts equally between all animals. Magnifica, however, disagreed with this and wanted all the nuts for herself. Eventually, the day came when the other animals had had enough.
atoms.sound: The previous rulers of the magical forest had been much nicer than Magnifica. It had been a tradition to distribute all nuts equally between all animals. Magnifica, however, disagreed with this and wanted all the nuts for herself. Eventually, the day came when the other animals had had enough.

atoms.text: They gathered in the middle of the forest to confront Magnifica, and finally, her secret was revealed! She was a squirrel and not a dragon! Magnifica soon realised that everybody in the forest was unhappy and decided to retreat. From that day on, the animals could enjoy their life in peace and eat as many nuts as they wanted, sharing them with one another.
